svg.aria-label: Co-expression — ESR1 against every gene — all patients
svg.title: Co-expression — ESR1 against every gene — all patients
svg.text: 20,057 genes against ESR1 · 15,572 at q < 0.05 · Spearman ρ
+150 more listed in the result and the MCP text; every one of the 20,057 genes is in the histogram
ESR1 on “rna_seq_v2_mrna” against every gene on “rna_seq_v2_mrna”, over the patients in “all patients” with both values (a patient's samples averaged, as the
heatmap takes them). Ranked by Spearman's ρ, as the portal ranks, with Pearson's r beside it; q is Benjamini–Hochberg over ρ's p across all 20,057 genes tested. A
correlation is not a regulatory link: genes that rise together across a cohort often both track a third thing — a subtype, the tumour's purity, proliferation. 280 genes were
not tested: fewer than 10 patients with both values, or no spread.
